scope: Warm-season field crops for the U.S. Great Plains and Corn Belt pilot sites (Hays, KS; Ames, IA). Parameters are FAO-56 tabulated values, not local calibrations.
notes: Winter wheat is left out of v0.1: its season crosses freezing months, which the water balance does not model (spec v4.0, section 5.3).

sources.kc_ini: FAO-56 Table 12, group i. Cereals (typical Kc ini; depends on wetting frequency)
sources.kc_end: FAO-56 Table 12, Maize, Field (grain): 0.35 for harvest after field drying (note 11)
sources.stages_days: FAO-56 Table 11, Maize (grain), April planting, Spain (spr, sum.); Calif. — the closest listed U.S. row for a 150-day hybrid; local calendar to confirm
sources.root_depth_m: FAO-56 Table 22 range 1.0-1.7 m; 'used' is the midpoint (assumed)
sources.planting_default: Assumed default; to confirm with USDA NASS 'Usual Planting and Harvesting Dates for U.S. Field Crops' for the state

sources.stages_days: FAO-56 Table 11, Soybeans, May planting, Central USA (development 30/35 days: 35 used)
sources.root_depth_m: FAO-56 Table 22 range 0.6-1.3 m; 'used' is the midpoint (assumed)
sources.planting_default: Assumed default; to confirm with USDA NASS 'Usual Planting and Harvesting Dates for U.S. Field Crops' for the state

sources.kc_mid: FAO-56 Table 12, Sorghum - grain, range 1.00-1.10; midpoint (assumed)

sources.root_depth_m: FAO-56 Table 22 range 1.0-2.0 m; 'used' is the midpoint (assumed)
